ex1En: He tried not to let the bad news spoil his party.
ex1Zh: 他盡量不讓那個壞消息毀了他的派對。
ex2En: Parents spoil their children by doing everything for them.
ex2Zh: 父母若什麼事都親力親為會寵壞孩子。
ex3En: Food will spoil in the fridge, too, only more slowly.
ex3Zh: 冰箱裡的食物也會腐敗，只是較慢罷了。

ex1En: His latest novel is selling really well.
ex1Zh: 他最新出版的小說十分暢銷。
ex2En: Everything is novel to a two-year-old child.
ex2Zh: 對一個兩歲小孩而言，一切事物都是新奇的。
ex3En: The novelty of these toys soon wore off.
ex3Zh: 這些玩具的新鮮感很快就消失了。

meaning: 持續的、經常的；恆定不變的事物；常數
ex1En: There are constant complaints about the noise from our neighbors.
ex1Zh: 不斷有人向我們抱怨鄰居的噪音。
ex2En: Her friendship is the one and only constant in his life.
ex2Zh: 她的友誼是他生命中唯一不變的事。
ex3En: It rains constantly in May.
ex3Zh: 五月經常下雨。

ex1En: The first safety razor was invented by King C. Gillette.
ex1Zh: 金・坎普・吉列發明第一把安全刮鬍刀。
ex2En: Franklin was a scientist, inventor, and statesman.
ex2Zh: 富蘭克林是科學家、發明家也是政治家。
ex3En: Necessity is the mother of invention.
ex3Zh: 需要為發明之母。

ex1En: Your skin needs protection from the sun's rays.
ex1Zh: 你的皮膚需要防曬。
ex2En: I still have a ray of hope that he'll recover.
ex2Zh: 我仍抱一絲希望他會復原。
ex3En: All baggage aboard must be examined by x-ray first.
ex3Zh: 所有登機行李需先經過 X 光的檢驗。

meaning: 鼓舞、使高興；歡呼；喝采；乾杯
ex1En: My mother always cheers me (up) when I am down.
ex1Zh: 母親總是在我失意時鼓勵我。
ex2En: The crowd cheered the Olympic medal winners.
ex2Zh: 群眾為奧運得獎選手歡呼。
ex3En: My brother remained cheerful and energetic throughout the trip.
ex3Zh: 我弟弟整趟旅途都很興高采烈、精力旺盛。

meaning: 閒聊、八卦；閒聊、談論是非
ex1En: They sat in the café having a good gossip about their friends.
ex1Zh: 他們坐在咖啡廳裡盡情聊朋友們的八卦。
ex2En: It is a stereotype that all housewives like to gossip.
ex2Zh: 家庭主婦都喜歡聊八卦是刻板印象。
ex3En: Don't spread gossip about others.
ex3Zh: 不要傳播關於他人的閒言閒語。

meaning: 傾倒；甩掉；垃圾堆、垃圾場
ex1En: Tons of garbage are dumped daily into the ocean.
ex1Zh: 每天都有好幾噸的垃圾被倒入海裡。
ex2En: He has been in a bad mood since he was dumped by his girlfriend.
ex2Zh: 自從他被女友甩掉後心情很不好。
ex3En: The locals voted against the plan to build a dump in their town.
ex3Zh: 當地居民投票反對在鎮上興建垃圾場。

meaning: 酪農場；乳製品販賣店；乳製品
ex1En: Local dairies let their cows graze freely on pastures.
ex1Zh: 當地的酪農場讓牛自在地在牧場上吃草。
ex2En: You can buy all kinds of cheese in the dairy.
ex2Zh: 你可以在乳製品專賣店裡買到各式各樣的乳酪。
ex3En: Most dairy products are made from cows' milk.
ex3Zh: 大部分乳製品原料來自牛乳。

ex1En: He has bought all the stuff we need for camping.
ex1Zh: 他已經買了我們露營所需的所有東西。
ex2En: They stuffed the pillows with cotton.
ex2Zh: 他們在枕頭裡塞棉花。
ex3En: I am stuffed. I can't eat another bite.
ex3Zh: 我吃得好飽啊！我一口也吃不下了。

ex1En: Please buy me a big jar of pickles when you go to the store.
ex1Zh: 你去商店時，請幫我買一大罐泡菜。
ex2En: She put the flower seeds in a small glass jar.
ex2Zh: 她把花種子放進一個小玻璃罐裡。
ex3En: The jam jar is hard to open.
ex3Zh: 果醬罐很難打開。

meaning: 黏貼；刺入；堅持；卡住；棍子、手杖
ex1En: You have to stick your picture on the form.
ex1Zh: 你必須把照片貼在表格上。
ex2En: Stick to your goal. Never give up.
ex2Zh: 堅持目標，不要放棄。
ex3En: I am stuck in the traffic jam.
ex3Zh: 我身陷車陣中。

meaning: 排(水)、流乾；消耗掉；排水管
ex1En: We drained the pool and filled it with fresh water.
ex1Zh: 我們放掉水池的水重新注滿乾淨的水。
ex2En: Constant war drained the country of people and money.
ex2Zh: 連年戰爭耗損這個國家的人力與金錢。
ex3En: All my time and money went down the drain.
ex3Zh: 我所有的時間跟金錢都白費了。

ex1En: Are you awake? Breakfast is ready.
ex1Zh: 你醒了嗎？早餐準備好了。
ex2En: When I awoke this morning, it was already eight o'clock.
ex2Zh: 當我今天早上醒來時已經八點了。
ex3En: Revisiting his hometown awoke his childhood memories.
ex3Zh: 返鄉喚起他的兒時回憶。

meaning: 碎片、渣；晶片；薄片；切下、打掉小片
ex1En: Chips of glass from a broken window are difficult to clean up.
ex1Zh: 窗戶的玻璃碎片很難清理。
ex2En: It is now a must for pet-keepers to put chips in their pets.
ex2Zh: 現在的飼主都必須為寵物植入晶片。
ex3En: She chipped a piece off her mother's favorite plate by accident.
ex3Zh: 她不小心將母親最喜歡的盤子弄破一小角。

ex1En: The alley led to the railway station.
ex1Zh: 這條巷子通往火車站。
ex2En: This is a quiet country lane.
ex2Zh: 這是條安靜的鄉間巷道。
ex3En: He changed lanes without giving any signals.
ex3Zh: 他沒有打方向燈就變換車道。

ex1En: UV rays can kill bacteria.
ex1Zh: 紫外線可殺菌。
ex2En: Bacteria play a big role in food decomposition.
ex2Zh: 細菌在食物分解中扮演重要角色。
ex3En: Yogurt contains bacteria that are good for health.
ex3Zh: 優格含有對健康有益的細菌。

ex1En: We used worms as bait when we went fishing.
ex1Zh: 我們釣魚時以蟲做餌。
ex2En: I knew he was baiting me, so I ignored him.
ex2Zh: 我知道他故意惹我生氣，所以不理他。
ex3En: There are all kinds of advertisements baiting prospective buyers.
ex3Zh: 各式各樣的廣告誘惑潛在買家。

ex1En: I was lucky that the beast didn't bite my arm off.
ex1Zh: 算我命大，那隻野獸沒咬斷我的手臂。
ex2En: The lion is known as the king of beasts.
ex2Zh: 獅子被稱為百獸之王。
ex3En: Beauty and the Beast is a famous fairy tale.
ex3Zh: 美女與野獸是著名的童話故事。

meaning: 莓果類、漿果；草莓、藍莓、蔓越莓
ex1En: There are lots of berries in the field.
ex1Zh: 原野上有很多漿果。
ex2En: The cake is decorated with strawberries, blueberries and mulberries.
ex2Zh: 這個蛋糕用草莓、藍莓和桑葚裝飾。
ex3En: Cranberries and raspberries contain lots of antioxidants.
ex3Zh: 蔓越莓與覆盆子富含抗氧化物。

ex1En: When you want to slow down, step on the brake.
ex1Zh: 當你想放慢車速時就踩煞車。
ex2En: I don't like to drive very fast and then brake (the car) hard.
ex2Zh: 我不喜歡開快車，然後再緊急踩煞車。
ex3En: My bicycle brakes need to be repaired.
ex3Zh: 我的腳踏車煞車需要修理。

meaning: 嫩芽、花苞；萌芽、開始發展
ex1En: Insects love to feed on the buds of trees most.
ex1Zh: 昆蟲最喜歡吃樹葉的嫩芽。
ex2En: The roses are budding.
ex2Zh: 這些玫瑰正在萌芽。
ex3En: Flowers in bud are most beautiful.
ex3Zh: 含苞待放的花朵最美。

ex1En: The price includes a buffet breakfast.
ex1Zh: 這個價格包括自助式早餐。
ex2En: I had my dinner at a cafeteria.
ex2Zh: 我在自助餐廳吃晚餐。
ex3En: The hotel offers a rich buffet dinner.
ex3Zh: 飯店提供豐盛的自助晚餐。

meaning: 撞擊；腫塊；路面突起；碰撞；不期而遇
ex1En: We all felt the bump when the boat hit the dock.
ex1Zh: 船撞到船塢時我們都感受到撞擊。
ex2En: I hit the cupboard in the head and got a bump.
ex2Zh: 我的頭撞到碗櫃腫了起來。
ex3En: I bumped into an old friend of mine the other day.
ex3Zh: 前幾天我碰到一位老朋友。

ex1En: Carpenters can make and repair wooden furniture.
ex1Zh: 木匠會製造或修繕木製傢俱。
ex2En: He hired a carpenter to make a dining table.
ex2Zh: 他雇用了一位木匠來製作一張餐桌。
ex3En: The carpenter is measuring the length of the wood.
ex3Zh: 木匠正在測量木頭的長度。

ex1En: Let's have a chat.
ex1Zh: 我們聊一聊吧！
ex2En: We were just chatting about what we did last weekend.
ex2Zh: 我們正在閒聊上個週末做了些什麼。
ex3En: Online chat rooms are popular among teenagers.
ex3Zh: 線上聊天室在青少年間很受歡迎。

ex1En: The girls are picking cherries.
ex1Zh: 女孩們正在摘櫻桃。
ex2En: Cherry yogurt is my favorite.
ex2Zh: 櫻桃口味的優格是我的最愛。
ex3En: The cherry blossom is the national flower of Japan.
ex3Zh: 櫻花是日本的國花。

ex1En: The museum is holding a special exhibition of porcelain.
ex1Zh: 博物館正在舉辦瓷器特展。
ex2En: Bone china is lighter and costlier.
ex2Zh: 骨瓷較輕也較貴。
ex3En: She collected exquisite porcelain teacups.
ex3Zh: 她收集精緻的瓷茶杯。

ex1En: Tom was chopping wood for fire.
ex1Zh: 湯姆正在劈柴生火。
ex2En: We will have pork chops and mushroom soup for dinner.
ex2Zh: 我們晚餐要吃豬排與蘑菇湯。
ex3En: He gave the tree several chops of an ax before it fell down.
ex3Zh: 他用斧頭砍了好幾次，樹才倒下。

ex1En: Children love being taken to the circus.
ex1Zh: 小孩喜歡被帶去看馬戲團。
ex2En: Without clowns, a circus is not a circus.
ex2Zh: 馬戲團沒有小丑就不成馬戲團了。
ex3En: Ben likes to make her laugh by clowning (around).
ex3Zh: 班喜歡扮小丑逗她笑。

ex1En: Patients with minor disorders should go to local clinics.
ex1Zh: 身體輕微不適的病人應在當地診所看診。
ex2En: Clinics and ward rounds are important in practical training.
ex2Zh: 在實際訓練上臨床研究與病房巡診很重要。
ex3En: The dental clinic is closed on Sundays.
ex3Zh: 牙科診所星期日休診。

ex1En: The mother rocked the cradle where her baby was lying.
ex1Zh: 媽媽搖著寶寶躺著的搖籃。
ex2En: The woman cradled the baby in her arms.
ex2Zh: 那位婦人將寶寶溫柔地抱在懷中。
ex3En: The Nile Valley is the cradle of the Egyptian civilization.
ex3Zh: 尼羅河谷是埃及文明的發源地。

meaning: 水壩；築壩攔水；壓抑情緒
ex1En: The Aswan High Dam is on the Nile in Egypt.
ex1Zh: 亞斯文高壩位於埃及的尼羅河上。
ex2En: Once a river is dammed up, the biological communities in it will be affected.
ex2Zh: 一旦河流受堤壩攔堵，該區的生物聚落將受到連帶影響。
ex3En: It is unhealthy to dam up your anger.
ex3Zh: 壓抑怒氣是不健康的。

meaning: 親愛的人；親愛的；迷人的
ex1En: Oh darling, I do love you.
ex1Zh: 哦！親愛的，我真的愛你。
ex2En: Happy birthday to my darling daughter.
ex2Zh: 我親愛的女兒，生日快樂！
ex3En: We just moved into our darling little apartment.
ex3Zh: 我們剛搬進自己的迷人小公寓。

meaning: 深度；(情感或知識的) 深度；加深
ex1En: Plant the seeds at a depth of about six inches.
ex1Zh: 將這些種子種在約六英吋深的地方。
ex2En: Have you ever thought about why your presentation lacked depth?
ex2Zh: 你有沒有想過為何你的報告欠缺深度呢？
ex3En: They deepened the well to get more water.
ex3Zh: 他們把井加深以獲取更多水。

meaning: 四分之一；一刻鐘；季度；二十五分錢硬幣；一角/一分硬幣
ex1En: She alone ate a quarter of the turkey.
ex1Zh: 她一個人吃了四分之一的火雞。
ex2En: It's a quarter past ten.
ex2Zh: 現在的時間是十點十五分。
ex3En: You need to have at least a quarter to make a local call.
ex3Zh: 打一通市內電話至少要一枚二角五分硬幣。

ex1En: Dip the fish in the batter, and then drop it into the hot oil.
ex1Zh: 將魚浸在麵糊裡然後丟進熱油。
ex2En: Mexicans love to eat corn chips with salsa dip.
ex2Zh: 墨西哥人喜歡吃玉米片配莎莎 (酸甜) 醬。
ex3En: Dip your pen in the ink.
ex3Zh: 把你的筆沾上墨水。

ex1En: I fell asleep on the way home and drove my car into a ditch.
ex1Zh: 我在回家途中睡著，因而把車開進大水溝裡。
ex2En: The suspect ditched the car and ran into the woods.
ex2Zh: 嫌犯棄車逃進樹林裡去。
ex3En: He ditched his wife of twenty years for a younger woman.
ex3Zh: 他為了一個年輕女子而拋棄結縭二十年的妻子。

meaning: 港口；心懷、懷有；碼頭；停靠
ex1En: Many ships took shelter from the storm in the harbor.
ex1Zh: 許多船隻入港躲避暴風雨。
ex2En: The two men harbor hatred toward each other.
ex2Zh: 這兩人彼此仇視。
ex3En: A crowd was waiting at the dock to greet them.
ex3Zh: 一大群人在碼頭等著迎接他們。

meaning: 羨慕、嫉妒；令 N 羨慕的對象
ex1En: She has a lifestyle which most people would envy.
ex1Zh: 她過著一種多數人都嫉妒的生活方式。
ex2En: He watched the others with envy.
ex2Zh: 他用羨慕的眼光看著其他人。
ex3En: Our health insurance system is the envy of the world.
ex3Zh: 我們的健保制度舉世稱羨。
